title: Dubai
subtitle: Mall atriums and the Burj Lake waterfront, sunset in Jumeirah and market lanes beside the creek.

cover.alt: Souk Al Bahar and tall modern towers across turquoise Burj Lake, with a floating walkway in the foreground.
cover.caption: Souk Al Bahar and tall modern towers across turquoise Burj Lake, with a floating walkway in the foreground.

chapters.title: Through the mall
paragraphs: A view from the train gives way to glazed walkways, escalators and tall atriums. Shopfronts and hanging decorations fill the mall interiors.

paragraphs: The Burj Khalifa rises above the turquoise lake. Sand-coloured arcades, quiet courtyards and modern towers surround the water.

chapters.title: Quiet streets in Jumeirah
paragraphs: The walk continues past white walls and low shopfronts. Bougainvillea, a passing cat and long shadows mark the quieter streets.

paragraphs: Visitors gather on the sand as the sun drops towards the water. Palms and beach huts catch the last warm light.
